svg.title: Three kinds of uncertainty about one summer day
svg.desc: Three stacked panels on the same water-use axis for a 90 degree weekday: the uncertainty about the mean, the uncertainty about a single day, and the same single day described by two different models, each with the 5.0 ceiling marked.
svg.text: Three kinds of uncertainty about the same 90 degree weekday
Each curve is a normal density rescaled to the same height, so only the widths and centres are being compared.
the mean use on such a
water delivered on the day, million gallons
Widening downward: one day is far less predictable than the mean of such days,
and the choice of model moves the centre as well as the width.
